Dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263)
I hope that in a day or two you will receive the proof of your [Royal Household](../others.html#262), which I should be much obliged to you to look over and return to

[Messrs Mozley](../others.html#108)

Friar Gate

Derby

I am setting off to see the Manchester Exhibition[^1] and from thence most probably to Ireland, so that you may judge my time and head are not in the most favorable state for correcting

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: The Manchester Art Treasures Exhibition, which had opened in May 1857.
